Metadata.title: Fakka — Track every penny
Metadata.description: Fakka helps you manage your personal expenses, simply.

Waitlist.title: Save your spot.
Waitlist.body: Join the list and we’ll invite you first.
Waitlist.privacy: We only email you about Fakka’s launch. We never share your details.
Waitlist.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

errors.verify: One moment, we’re checking you’re not a bot. Try again in a few seconds.
errors.verifyBlocked: We couldn’t load the bot check. Turn off any ad blocker or reload the page, then try again.
errors.tooMany: Too many tries. Wait a minute, then try again.

success.body: Each friend who joins with your link moves you up the queue.

Email.subject: You’re #{position} on the Fakka waitlist
Email.invite: Want to move up? Share your invite link. Each friend who joins with it moves you up the queue.
Email.launch: We’ll email you when Fakka is ready. There’s no date yet, but you’ll hear it from us first.
Email.footer: You’re getting this because you joined the Fakka waitlist on fakka.com. We only email you about Fakka’s launch, and we never share your details.

Hero.title: Where did your salary <highlight>go</highlight> this month?
Hero.body: Fakka helps you note every expense in seconds and see exactly where your money went. Made for Egypt, in EGP.
Hero.reassure: Free to join. We’ll email you when it’s ready.

Footer.privacy: We keep only what the waitlist needs. Never shared or sold.

Legal.draftNotice: This page is still a draft. Anything in [square brackets] is still being confirmed.

fast.title: Add it in seconds
fast.body: Paid for something? Note the amount and what it was for, and you’re done.

month.title: See your month
month.body: How much you spent, and on what. One clear look each month.

egypt.title: Made for Egypt
egypt.body: Amounts in EGP. Use it in Arabic or English.

what.a: An upcoming app that helps you track your personal expenses. Add what you spend in seconds, and at the end of the month you’ll see how much went where.

who.a: Anyone in Egypt with a monthly salary or freelance income who wants to know where it goes. If you manage your money on your phone, it’s for you.

when.a: We haven’t set a date yet. Join the waitlist and you’ll be among the first to hear.

queue.a: When you join, you get a place in the queue and your own invite link. Each friend who joins through it moves you up. You can’t invite yourself, and each friend counts once.

data.q: What do you do with my data?
data.a: We keep only what the waitlist needs: your name, email, language, when you joined, and who invited you. We never share or sell it, and we only email you about Fakka’s launch.

join.title: Join the list
join.body: It takes ten seconds, and you get your place right away.

invite.title: Invite friends
invite.body: Share your link. Every friend who joins moves you up.

receive.title: Get your invite
receive.body: When it’s your turn, we’ll email you.
